summary: This note is a short wiki-style biography stub on Sergey Balasanian, recording the honors he received. It lists the State Prize of the USSR in 1949 and five orders, plus two artistic titles: People's Artist of the Tajik SSR (1957) and Honored Art Worker of the Russian SFSR (1963). The note gives no further biographical detail such as profession or birth details.
one_line: Sergey Balasanian's honors, including the 1949 USSR State Prize, five orders, and two Soviet artistic titles.
key_facts: Sergey Balasanian was awarded the State Prize of the USSR in 1949.
